answer: A farm running 119 keys as a result burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. Because the zephyr stake is held until the crystal settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the falcon audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 11% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
